policy: Every retained import, subprocess and tool operation must map to this inventory. Installation is distinct from connection and successful operation. No credentials or original account bindings belong here.

capabilities.setup: Use Python 3.10+ on a POSIX host with fcntl and IANA timezone data. No third-party toolkit packages.
limits: Windows/cloud are not certified.
capabilities.fallback: Report missing capability and hold only affected work; never bypass permissions or use alternate Google credentials.

capabilities.setup: Optional public HTTP CLI; use an already supported native public HTTP reader instead when available. https://curl.se/download.html
limits: No Google alternate auth, cookies or credential export.
capabilities.fallback: Use verified native public HTTP with TLS and bounded timeouts; do not install curl solely to pass core readiness.

capabilities.setup: Verify actual private root and producer workspace grants with scoped write/readback, atomic-file support and exclusive writer ownership.
capabilities.fallback: Report missing capability and hold only affected work; never bypass permissions or use alternate Google credentials.

capabilities.setup: Create or adopt the selected central and helper chats under explicit setup authorization; verify each actual workspace. No unselected chat is required.
capabilities.fallback: Report missing capability and hold only affected work; never bypass permissions or use alternate Google credentials.

capabilities.setup: Verify dispatch authorization and an actual scoped handoff only for the selected helper chats.
capabilities.fallback: Keep the selected helper branch partial; do not dispatch an unselected chat.

capabilities.setup: Inspect actual worker/model capacity and per-worker grants when choosing parallel research. Sequential verification is supported; selected helper chats do not require sub-agents.
capabilities.fallback: Run independent checks sequentially; preserve the same frozen scope, retries and source coverage.

capabilities.setup: Bind supported automation create/view/update. Create only after verified live pass, then read back timing, chat, status, notifications and next run.
capabilities.fallback: Report missing capability and hold only affected work; never bypass permissions or use alternate Google credentials.

capabilities.setup: Connect Gmail only for selected alert discovery, Gmail tracking, or authorized self-email. Verify identity, individual message pagination and full MIME readback. Configure alert queries only when alert discovery is selected.
limits: Equivalent schemas may be bound by the native host adapter. Label/attachment writes are not implied.
capabilities.fallback: Report missing capability and hold only affected work; never bypass permissions or use alternate Google credentials.

capabilities.setup: Explicitly opt in to the named brief recipient. Verify bounded test/first-pass send with exact Sent readback and uncertain-send reconciliation.
capabilities.fallback: Report missing capability and hold only affected work; never bypass permissions or use alternate Google credentials.

capabilities.setup: Verify one shared workbook for main and Blind, header schema/basic filters/validation and authorized write/readback. Single coordinator writer.
limits: Native readback does not imply atomic revision comparison.
capabilities.fallback: Report missing capability and hold only affected work; never bypass permissions or use alternate Google credentials.

capabilities.setup: Import sanitized template or create native workbook with declared schema; save returned ID, read native schema. Folders/index are optional.
capabilities.fallback: Report missing capability and hold only affected work; never bypass permissions or use alternate Google credentials.

capabilities.provider: host public search/open and bounded public HTTP
tool_operations: verified native public HTTP reader or optional curl
capabilities.setup: Verify supported public search/open and public HTTP with TLS, bounded timeouts and shared retry ledger.
limits: Source gaps remain gaps; no authenticated fallback bypass.
capabilities.fallback: Report missing capability and hold only affected work; never bypass permissions or use alternate Google credentials.

capabilities.setup: Inspect and use actual in-app browser; verify task-owned tab navigation and controls.
limits: One browser controller, even with different tabs.
capabilities.fallback: Report missing capability and hold only affected work; never bypass permissions or use alternate Google credentials.

capabilities.setup: For selected authenticated job access or separately requested manual application/recruiter work, verify the supported browser bridge, session and expected identity. Public research and native Gmail do not themselves require authenticated Chrome. LinkedIn alert onboarding verifies its signed-in setup separately.
limits: No autofill, uploads or submission.
capabilities.fallback: Report missing capability and hold only affected work; never bypass permissions or use alternate Google credentials.

capabilities.setup: Connect and select exact calendar; verify bounded event reads.
limits: No booking or RSVP.
capabilities.fallback: Report missing capability and hold only affected work; never bypass permissions or use alternate Google credentials.

tool_operations: tool_check_addressbook (only when contact resolution is selected)
packages: user-selected upstream mac-messages-mcp release and its resolved dependencies; not bundled
executables: upstream-supported launcher such as uvx; separate optional install
capabilities.setup: Optional only: follow https://github.com/carterlasalle/mac_messages_mcp and https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/extend/mcp. Register local stdio, record the installed version, allow only reviewed read tools, and verify the configured conversation/date window. No custom wrapper, Swift build or local decoder is required. See Application Workflow/docs/messages.md.
limits: macOS and user-granted database access required; no permissions are changed by the checker.
Sending, scheduling, availability probes, contact writes and audio fetching/transcription are outside this workflow.
Saved Apple transcript text is used only if an installed tool actually exposes it; unsupported decoding remains a gap.
A bounded page, contact search or truncated result never proves complete conversation coverage.
capabilities.fallback: Leave Messages disabled until verified, or report its selected source as partial/unavailable. Continue core job discovery and shared-tracker work; never broaden to other conversations.

capabilities.setup: Core Simplify decoding uses Python zlib. Discover supported bundled Node for local Excel storage or optional artifact rebuild/export; do not require Node for pure Python toolkit tests.
capabilities.fallback: Report missing capability and hold only affected work; never bypass permissions or use alternate Google credentials.

capabilities.setup: Use the host-provided bundled runtime for local Excel storage or optional rebuild/export; never install the private artifact package from npm. Local Excel is a storage backend, not merely an export option.
limits: Recorded audit version 2.8.99 is not a universal minimum.
Prebuilt template/native Sheets daily operations do not need rebuild tooling.
permitted_effects: authorized local workbook creation, editing and export
capabilities.fallback: Report missing capability and hold only affected work; never bypass permissions or use alternate Google credentials.

capabilities.setup: Include only after explicit scoped manual request. Bound StatusDates.gs onEdit is optional; API writes need explicit date logic.
limits: No sends/invitations; no automatic dispatch.
capabilities.fallback: Report missing capability and hold only affected work; never bypass permissions or use alternate Google credentials.

executables: uv/uvx only when chosen for optional Messages
capabilities.setup: Use the upstream installation route selected by the user, e.g. https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/. Core Python helpers need no package installer.
capabilities.fallback: Report missing capability and hold only affected work; never bypass permissions or use alternate Google credentials.

capabilities.setup: Run synthetic tests with Python -B and temp writable directories. No accounts or pytest are needed.
capabilities.fallback: Report missing capability and hold only affected work; never bypass permissions or use alternate Google credentials.

tool_operations: installed Messages MCP handshake/catalog and scoped read tools
capabilities.setup: Only after optional source authorization, verify a bounded configured-conversation read, pagination and identity through the actual MCP. See Application Workflow/docs/messages.md. Saved transcripts are checked only when available; no shipped wrapper or decoder is assumed.
capabilities.fallback: Report the optional source as disabled/partial; core setup can continue.

capabilities.setup: Git is useful for cloning/upgrades; use maintained Python equivalents for copy/hash/locking. Do not assume Homebrew/login-shell settings.
capabilities.fallback: Report missing capability and hold only affected work; never bypass permissions or use alternate Google credentials.

tool_operations: optional OpenAI Docs/plugin-management for setup troubleshooting
capabilities.setup: Use supported Google Drive/Sheets and spreadsheet skills where their host capabilities require them; do not hardcode personal skill-cache paths. Personal writing/coding skills are not adopter dependencies.
capabilities.fallback: Report missing capability and hold only affected work; never bypass permissions or use alternate Google credentials.

capabilities.provider: private XLSX through the shipped local adapter
capabilities.setup: Use the selected private XLSX path. Initialize through the artifact runtime, reserve a local tracker intent, bind actual reopened file evidence, and verify current local schema and hyperlink targets. No Google account is needed.
limits: Close the workbook in Excel before writes; conflicting or unsupported workbook features stop the affected write.
permitted_effects: authorized local workbook creation and journaled writes
capabilities.fallback: Keep the selected local branch blocked; do not silently switch to Google or overwrite an unknown file.

capabilities.provider: selected LinkedIn browser and mailbox setup controls
tool_operations: supported signed-in LinkedIn browser: inspect/create chosen search alerts
Gmail native list_labels/create_label: selected setup only
Gmail native filter read/create only if exposed; otherwise user follows Gmail settings steps
Outlook selected native folder/rule tools or supported browser: organization only
selected Gmail search/full-message reads for post-rule delivery proof
capabilities.setup: Follow Application Workflow/docs/linkedin-alerts.md when LinkedIn email discovery is selected. Reuse equivalent alerts/rules, preview a narrow scope, save private readiness evidence, and verify an actual received alert outside Inbox. This setup guide is separate from doctor; this release consumes Gmail only.
limits: Label creation does not prove native filter capability or automatic routing.
No new dependency, credential flow, permanent chat or schedule is implied.
Setup mutation authorization does not extend to daily discovery.
Outlook folders are not currently inputs to the shipped Gmail reader.
permitted_effects: readback of selected settings and actual alert delivery
capabilities.fallback: Give precise user settings steps when a required mutation tool is absent. Keep awaiting_first_alert or reader gaps visible; do not fabricate a doctor receipt, switch accounts or create forwarding automatically.

replacements.current: maintained Python standard-library components; no bs4 or Node decoder installation
